label: Ejection policy
type: the per-bucket setting governing what is removed from memory when the bucket's memory quota is reached. Values differ by bucket type: Couchbase buckets choose value-only or full ejection, ephemeral buckets choose no-ejection or eject-when-full.
note: Head of the enum. The genuinely surprising structure, and the reason this is one concept and not two: the *setting* is shared across bucket types but its *value set* is not - a Couchbase bucket and an ephemeral bucket have disjoint legal values for the same named setting. The registry has no predicate that states a value set conditional on another concept's value; recorded as a modelling gap on the watchlist rather than forced into usesEnum.
